messages:
Anya Patel: Hey team — we need to lock down an access review + threat-modeling sync next week. Goal: quick triage of outstanding IAM gaps, confirm owners for service-account sweep, and prep audit pre-reads. 30–45m.
Sam Lin: +1. Can we keep it 30m? timezone-friendly would be nice (PST/UTC overlap).
Marta Gomez: 30m works. Would like a short section for privacy implications (data flows).
Kevin Zhao: I can cover the infra access matrix and list of active roles. Prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.
Anya Patel: Proposed slots: Tue 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC / Wed 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC / Thu 2026-03-26 13:00 UTC. Pick what works.
Priya (Legal): I can attend for the privacy bit on Wed, but not Tue.
Sam Lin: Wed 17:00 UTC works for me.
Marta Gomez: Wed works. Add a 5-min 'who owns what' after the triage so we leave with clear action items.
Anya Patel: Agenda draft: 1) 5m goal + scope (auditor checklist tl;dr) 2) 10m access matrix highlights (Kevin) 3) 10m threat-model spots & privacy flags (Marta) 4) 5m owners + next steps 5) 5m blockers/notes. Any changes?
Kevin Zhao: Suggest swapping 2 & 3 — threat spots often drive immediate role fixes.
Anya Patel: OK swap noted. Updated agenda: 1) kickoff 2) threat-model spots (Marta) 3) access matrix (Kevin) 4) owners + next steps 5) blockers.
sec-bot: Poll created: "Which slot for Access/Threat review?" Options: Wed 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC (A), Thu 2026-03-26 13:00 UTC (B). Vote here: https://poll.mock/redwood/acc-review
Infra Oncall Bot: FYI — I've attached the current roles dump to the calendar invite (files are in #eng-security-files).
Sam Lin: Voted A.
Marta Gomez: Voted A.
Priya (Legal): I'll RSVP once I get the calendar invite.
Anya Patel: Thanks — looks like Wed (A) is winning. Can someone add the pre-read list and minimal artifacts we need? I propose: 1) current IAM export, 2) list of active service accounts, 3) recent deploys with elevated perms, 4) brief auditor checklist.
Kevin Zhao: I'll push IAM export and svc account list to #eng-security-files by EOD Monday.
Marta Gomez: I'll draft a 1-page privacy/dataflow note highlighting high-risk services.
Sam Lin: I'll put together the auditor checklist + what to expect re: scope (access recert, service account controls).
Anya Patel: Great. If we get those in, we can keep the meeting tight. Please mark items with `owner:` in the doc so we can assign quickly.
Priya (Legal): Noted — I'll prepare a 2-min legal constraints slide and add to the files.
sec-bot: Scheduled event created: "Access & Threat Review" Wed 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC — invite sent to participants.
Anya Patel: Perfect. One last ask — can someone run a quick skip-level check for rambler service accounts (they tend to be orphaned)? Command we used last time: `gcloud iam service-accounts list --filter="email:.*rambler.*"` and then `gcloud projects get-iam-policy <proj> --flatten=bindings`.
Kevin Zhao: On it. I'll run the sweep and attach results.
Sam Lin: If anyone can't make it, please leave your priorities in the doc and tag an alternate owner.
Marta Gomez: Thanks — looking forward to a focused sync. :thumbsup:
Anya Patel: Thanks all, closing thread — will post final agenda + files link in the invite before EOD Monday.
